saw_lines: Market stall owners and caterers reorder disposables by pack size, so they compare case prices before reading ad copy.
So buyers see no proof in your ads and no first order offer, so no reason to pick you over rivals.
Your one live Meta ad carries no proof number. Lead it with one review count or orders shipped, then test that opening line against two more ads built the same way.
